rules: Daily content takes precedence for daily_single; do not substitute general love/spread text when a daily field is missing.
Keep concrete card-specific meaning; do not turn every card into generic reassurance.
Preserve challenging meanings while phrasing them gently.
Offer a practical action; do not promise an event or another person's thoughts as certain.
Keep scope today; long-term topics may become an action to begin today, never a claim the long-term result will happen today.
No automatic percent scores, disease labels, nationality/appearance predictions, exact timing, lottery odds, or four-region temple lists in the homepage template.
User prompts and corrections are source evidence; assistant continuations remain drafts until explicitly reviewed.
Store new advice separately as a proposed editorial addition, with provenance; never silently append it as owner-approved.
missing_content_policy: Return an explicit missing field for editor review; do not generate or borrow a replacement automatically.
